editor.methodIntro.source: 自动布局设计固定64点并均衡分配。“电极编辑”可从已有布局删减或移动点位，允许各区数量不同，另存为独立评价。查看模式旋转头部，编辑模式移动电极。
editor.methodIntro.en: Automatic layout design uses 64 electrodes with balanced allocation. Electrode Editor can deactivate or move recorded electrodes, allow unequal regional counts, and save separate evaluations. View mode rotates the head; edit mode moves electrodes.

editor.methodTitle.source: 电极编辑：数量与位置的独立评价
editor.methodTitle.en: Electrode editing: separate evaluation of count and position

editor.methodDomain.source: 载入有保存区域边界的真实64点布局。保留稳定编号，移除点位不补点、不重新分配；移动吸附到原区域内已有FEM结果的候选点。原区域面积不随删点改变。
editor.methodDomain.en: Load a recorded 64-electrode layout with saved region boundaries. IDs remain stable; deactivation neither replaces nor redistributes electrodes. Movement snaps to candidate points with existing FEM results within the original region. Deactivation does not change its area.

editor.methodMath.source: 编辑后只使用启用点的前向矩阵，并重新计算参考无关对比、重建器及指标。N个启用点提供N−1个参考无关维度，重建目标始终是标准64的63维干净场。噪声仍由标准64标定，不能随删点重新归一化。
editor.methodMath.en: Evaluation uses only active electrodes' forward rows and recomputes reference-free contrasts, the estimator and metrics. N active electrodes provide N−1 reference-free dimensions; the target remains the 63-dimensional clean standard64 field. Noise stays calibrated to standard64 and is not rescaled after deletion.

editor.methodLoc.source: 标准64、原始布局和编辑布局在同一协议下重新评价。定位沿用4096字典源、256离字典生成源和每源16次噪声重复；删点前后按稳定槽位配对噪声。仅有2点时未知振幅定位不可辨识，定位显示不可用。
editor.methodLoc.en: Standard64, the original layout and the edited layout are re-evaluated under one protocol. Localization uses 4,096 dictionary sources, 256 off-dictionary sources and 16 noise repetitions per source, paired by stable electrode slots. With only two electrodes, unknown-amplitude localization is unidentifiable and reported as unavailable.

editor.methodRecords.source: 编辑草稿与已评价结果分开保存。修改点位后旧评分失效；评价结果使用独立缓存，不加入固定64点实验曲线。当前编辑记录不接入只支持完整64点的信号仿真入口。
editor.methodRecords.en: Drafts and evaluated results are saved separately. Editing invalidates previous scores; evaluations use a separate cache and do not enter fixed64 experiment curves. Edited records are not currently passed to Signal Simulation, which requires a complete 64-electrode layout.

editor.missingMetric.source: 部分指标不可用，不能给出三项共同达标结论
editor.missingMetric.en: Some metrics are unavailable; a three-metric pass cannot be determined

editor.connection.source: 状态连接中断，后台任务尚未确认结束。
editor.connection.en: The status connection was lost. The background task has not been confirmed as stopped.

editor.drag.source: 编辑模式下拖动电极，吸附到原区域候选点；空白处旋转。灰色点已停用。
editor.drag.en: In edit mode, drag electrodes to candidate positions within their original region. Drag empty space to rotate. Grey electrodes are inactive.

editor.title.source: 电极编辑：调整点位与启用数量
editor.title.en: Electrode Editor: positions and active channels

editor.intro.source: 从已有布局创建副本。原区域边界不变，原始64点记录不被覆盖。
editor.intro.en: Create a copy of a recorded layout. Keep its original region boundaries and preserve the original 64-electrode record.

editor.chooseHint.source: 载入后显示真实点位与可移动范围。历史记录若未保存区域边界，需要先在布局设计中生成新版布局。
editor.chooseHint.en: Load recorded coordinates and allowed movement regions. Historical records without saved region boundaries require a new layout from Layout Design.

editor.selectHint.source: 点击点位选择；Shift点击多选。也可在下方按编号选择。拖动仅在编辑模式生效。
editor.selectHint.en: Click an electrode to select it; Shift-click to select several. You can also select by ID below. Dragging electrodes requires edit mode.

editor.saveDraft.source: 保存草稿到本机浏览器

editor.savedDraft.source: 草稿已保存在此浏览器；尚未生成新评分。
editor.savedDraft.en: Draft saved in this browser. No new scores have been generated.

editor.noDraft.en: No draft is saved for this layout.

editor.countError.source: 至少保留两个启用电极。
editor.countError.en: Keep at least two active electrodes.

editor.regionError.source: 点位必须位于其原区域候选列表内。
editor.regionError.en: Each electrode must stay within its original region's candidate list.

editor.spacingError.source: 操作未应用：启用电极之间需至少4 mm间距。
editor.spacingError.en: Change not applied: active electrodes must remain at least 4 mm apart.

editor.evaluate.en: Evaluate and save as a new layout

editor.single.source: 选择一个电极，可用候选编号精确移动；也可直接拖动。
editor.single.en: Select one electrode to move precisely by candidate ID, or drag it on the head.

editor.summary.source: 当前启用 {{0}} 点 · {{1}} 个有电极区域 / {{2}} 个原区域

editor.area.source: 继承区域总面积 {{0}} cm²；删点不会缩小区域边界。
editor.area.en: Inherited total region area: {{0}} cm². Deactivation does not shrink the region boundaries.

editor.comparison.source: 标准64、原始布局与编辑布局

editor.protocol.source: 三套布局按本次统一协议重新评价：同一头模与源先验、相同物理噪声、固定标准64重建目标。历史定位分数不直接混入此表。
editor.protocol.en: All three layouts are re-evaluated under one protocol: the same head and source prior, equal physical noise, and the fixed clean standard64 target. Historical localization scores are not mixed into this table.

editor.pending.source: 当前草稿尚未评价。下方原评分不作为编辑后结果。
editor.pending.en: This draft has not been evaluated. Previous scores do not describe the edited draft.

editor.locMissing.source: 两个电极只有一个参考无关维度；当前未知振幅定位模型无法辨识源位置，不提供三项共同达标结论。
editor.locMissing.en: Two electrodes provide one reference-free dimension. The current unknown-amplitude localization model cannot identify source position; a three-metric pass cannot be determined.

editor.savedScoreHint.source: 载入为草稿，重新评价时检查协议与缓存
editor.savedScoreHint.en: Loads as a draft; evaluation checks the protocol and cache

editor.pass.source: 三项均达到最低保留要求
editor.pass.en: All three metrics meet the minimum required retention

editor.fail.source: 尚未全部达到最低保留要求
editor.fail.en: Not all metrics meet the minimum required retention

editor.unavailable.source: 定位指标不可用，不能给出三项共同达标结论
editor.unavailable.en: Localization is unavailable; a three-metric pass cannot be determined

editor.recordHint.source: 已完成评价单独缓存，不加入固定64点实验曲线。载入后可继续编辑；再次评价相同配置会优先读取有效缓存。
editor.recordHint.en: Completed evaluations are cached separately and kept out of fixed64 experiment curves. Load a record to continue editing; evaluating the same configuration reuses a valid cache.

editor.noRecords.source: 尚无电极编辑评价记录。

editor.cached.source: 本次评价读取有效缓存
editor.cached.en: Evaluation loaded from a valid cache

editor.unsaved.source: 当前有未保存的编辑，确认切换布局？
editor.unsaved.en: This layout has unsaved edits. Switch layouts?

editor.draftStale.source: 草稿来源已变化，请重新载入原布局。
editor.draftStale.en: The draft's source has changed. Reload the original layout.

editor.movement.source: 区内候选点吸附 · 最小点距4 mm · 移除不补点 · 原编号保持不变
editor.movement.en: Snap within original regions · 4 mm minimum spacing · No automatic replacement · Stable electrode IDs

editor.canvasLabel.source: 可旋转的头部与电极布局，启用{{0}}点，方向键旋转，加减键缩放
editor.canvasLabel.en: Rotatable head and electrode layout with {{0}} active electrodes. Arrow keys rotate; plus and minus zoom.
